description: This file defines an internal interface 'IGrainTimerRegistry' used for recording the creation and disposal of grain timers within the Orleans runtime. It declares two methods, 'OnTimerCreated' and 'OnTimerDisposed', which are called to notify the registry of timer lifecycle events.

methods.name: OnTimerCreated
methods.description: Notifies the registry that a grain timer has been created.

methods.name: OnTimerDisposed
methods.description: Notifies the registry that a grain timer has been disposed.
